data.content: {"requirements":[{"unit_ids":["u1"],"source_quote":"Task titles are mandatory; cannot be empty.","kind":"validation_rule","statement":"A task cannot be saved unless its title is non-empty."},{"unit_ids":["u2"],"source_quote":"Due Date cannot be earlier than the Creation Date.","kind":"validation_rule","statement":"The system rejects a task whose Due Date is earlier than its Creation Date."},{"unit_ids":["u3"],"source_quote":"Deleting a task requires a prompt confirmation.","kind":"functional","statement":"Deleting a task requires the user to confirm the deletion first."},{"unit_ids":["u4"],"source_quote":"Success or error messages must be displayed after create/update/delete actions.","kind":"frontend","statement":"The UI displays a success or error message after every create, update and delete action."},{"unit_ids":["u5"],"source_quote":"Optimistic UI updates are not allowed: if a Backend action fails, the Frontend must not reflect a successful state.","kind":"constraint","statement":"The Frontend must not show a successful state for an action whose Backend call has failed; optimistic UI updates are not allowed."}]}
